headline: Gold rebounds about 1.4% today, silver up 3%, both still below last month's levels
summary: 24K gold is ₹12,655 per gram, up ₹175 (about 1.4%) from yesterday, and 22K is ₹11,600, up ₹160. Over the last seven days gold has moved only about 0.8% higher, but over the 33 days since 26 October it is down about 11%, after peaking on 5 November and dipping to a low on 25 November. Silver is ₹1,70,000 per kg, up ₹5,000 (about 3%) today, though it is still about 23% below its 26 October level. Today's rise likely reflects the rebound from last week's lows, with the US dollar and rupee moves and festive or wedding demand as possible influences.
outlook: If you are buying jewellery or coins, today's rates are close to the recent lows, but prices can swing day to day, so compare the making charges and GST at your jeweller before deciding.
